why: Close-up of a carpenter's hands paring a timber block with a chisel, shavings on a dark bench, shallow depth of field: hand craft and cabinet making without faces, logos or text (the vice label is out of focus and unreadable). Coverr's carpentry clips were flat daylight with DeWalt branding. Graded into the industry family: darker curve, less saturation, cool shadows, light vignette, so the warm wood echoes the amber accent. Used src 1.52-9.12 s, 7.0 s loop; the 0.6 s seam is a DIS optical-flow morph from the tail to the head, so the chisel is not doubled. The action sits in the upper-middle band above the headline. Poster = loop 2.32 s, the chisel biting in with a shaving
